name: Residence Permit for an Entrepreneur / Start-Up Entrepreneur

requirements.blocker_text: The Economic Development Centre (ELY-keskus) assesses whether the business is profitable and can support the applicant; ownership alone is not sufficient -- the applicant must actually work in the company in Finland.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a positive assessment from the ELY-keskus.

requirements.blocker_text: Means of support must come from the applicant's own income from the business, not external funding.
Requires a positive Business Finland Eligibility Statement, no more than 4 months old at application, for a first start-up-entrepreneur permit or a first extension.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a positive Eligibility Statement from Business Finland.

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold sufficient documented funds in a personal bank account -- 2026 minimum net monthly equivalent is EUR 1,030-1,210 depending on region -- from savings, start-up income, company funding, or other regular income, covering at least 1 year (2 years of funding needed for a 2-year permit).

evidence_required.document: ELY-keskus assessment (standard route) or Business Finland Eligibility Statement (start-up route)

outcome.duration_length: standard entrepreneur: first/extended permit duration not specified at tier-1 precision in this pass; start-up entrepreneur: up to 2 years initial, up to 4 years extended with continuous income proof

Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Residence Permit Application for a Start-Up Entrepreneur: Business Finland Eligibility Statement, 2026 funds requirement (EUR 1,030-1,210/month by region), permit duration

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). Two structurally distinct sub-routes bundled into one file since both fall under the 'entrepreneur' residence-permit family: the standard entrepreneur route (assessed by ELY-keskus, no fixed threshold, business must already be profitable) and the start-up entrepreneur route (assessed by Business Finland, explicit monthly funds figures). The standard route's permit duration was not confirmed at tier-1 precision -- flagged as a gap.
